title: Card (rules identity)
description: The RULES identity of a card — stable across reprints, alternate art, and printings. Two-tier model (Scryfall oracle_id / NRDB v2 consensus): what a card DOES lives here; how a specific physical copy LOOKS lives in Printing. Files: components/cards.json is an array of these.

id.description: Stable opaque ID. NEVER reused, NEVER positional, survives renames. This is what diffs, printings, rulings, and banlists reference.

subtypes.description: Structured list — never a ' - '-joined string (NRDB v1 lesson).

text.description: Current canonical rules text (post-errata). Inline symbols as [key] tags per game.yaml symbols. History of changes lives in git; dated clarifications live in rulings/.

attributes.description: Game-specific fields (cost, power, faction...). Keys should be declared in game.yaml attribute_definitions for typed validation.

deck_limit.description: Max copies per deck, if the game has decks. Omit if not applicable.

orientation.description: Physical card orientation. Omit to assume the game's default (portrait).

tags.description: Machine-readable hooks for deckbuilding/validation rules (ArkhamDB pattern).
